services.name: snd_expand_sample_resource
services.protection_basis: No local CLI/STI or sound interrupt-disable/enable calls; inherits caller IF.
services.inclusion: Ordering service only when entry type argument equals 5; every other foreground invocation remains an unqualified diagnostic observation.

evidence.argument_location: Large-model far entry: return IP:CS 4 bytes, handle far pointer 4, size far pointer 4, object word 2, then type word at SP+14. PUSH BP makes type BP+16.
evidence.negative_path: For every type other than 5: stack/register prologue, CMP of type stack argument, JNE directly to stack/register epilogue and RETF. No global/resource/shared-sound-state read or write, nested call, I/O, CLI or STI.
evidence.positive_path: Type 5 reaches the sample body: size dereference and write, sample allocation/decoding, old handle release and replacement.

compiled_argument_proof.method: Execute each executable own independently symbol-bound 144-byte x86-16 function in Unicorn for all 65536 argument words; stop at first sample-body LES or RETF. Reverse JNE to JE as mutation contrast.

services.diagnostic_retention: Record all live foreground callback entries with id, caller, object/type and qualification; type!=5 does not increment service ordinal or consume a chronological sound ID.

flags_policy: CLI/STI are assignments to IF, never nested locks; none of the source C wrappers save FLAGS. Protection is local shared-operation coverage with specifically reviewed nested STI exceptions; fully does not preserve caller FLAGS or claim IF=0 on function entry. Unmasked helpers can inherit IF=0 from callers. No local masking is not a proof that all callees keep IF unchanged.
native_missing_policy: Keep DOS service IDs for missing native leaves. Any observed missing foreground leaf is an explicit unsupported/replay coverage failure.
limits: Static reachability overapproximates runtime branches; source_data_identifiers records direct named references, not complete alias/read-write proof.
ISR-only scheduler helpers excluded based on current source callers, not merely unobserved traces.
No claim every conservative public entry is exercised by shipped profile.
entry_guard_policy: Evaluate only explicit source-argument predicates at function ENTRY. ID20 type==5 is the sole guard; type!=5 is retained diagnostically with no ordering-service increment. No expected state, hashes, resource identities, cache outcome or observed call counts select qualification.
